planned_title: Why Did a 90-Day Mars Rover Last 14 Years?
replaces_for_review: wed11_opening_testA_v02 (scheduled TtgHNLXfDSs). v01 and v02 not overwritten.
spoken: 14 years. on Mars. This rover was built to last 90 days Dust should have choked its solar panels within months. It wears them down slowly in ways you already know from home. The cold that kills a phone battery, Martian wind kept sweeping them clean. Then in 2018, a storm wrapped the whole planet and the sky went dark.
loop_sentence: …and the sky went dark. Fourteen years on Mars.
